scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The Connection Lab
scenes.caption: The Connection Lab studies a fictional message claiming to send a club refund. It includes a pretend code. The teacher shows the destination screen separately: it describes sending tokens out of the classroom wallet, even though the message promised that tokens would come in.
scenes.speech: The Connection Lab studies a fictional message claiming to send a club refund. It includes a pretend code. The teacher shows the destination screen separately: it describes sending tokens out of the classroom wallet, even though the message promised that tokens would come in.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: What changed?
scenes.caption: A code is a way to carry information or open a destination; its pattern does not verify a sender or explain every later action. Tara compares the displayed purpose with the original claim. The mismatch matters more than a polished code, familiar logo or promise of an easy refund.
scenes.speech: A code is a way to carry information or open a destination; its pattern does not verify a sender or explain every later action. Tara compares the displayed purpose with the original claim. The mismatch matters more than a polished code, familiar logo or promise of an easy refund.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.caption: The class does not scan a real code, use a payment service or enter a PIN. All tokens and screens are invented. Neel pauses and asks a trusted adult to review the request through a known route. Adult support is needed for real financial decisions, and no code should replace reading the action being authorised.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Decide and explain
scenes.caption: Claim: tokens come in. Fictional destination screen: send tokens out. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Check the consequence
scenes.caption: No. Pause the outgoing action and ask a trusted adult to check through a known route. The code’s appearance cannot resolve the contradiction.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Investigate in the lab
scenes.caption: Investigate claimed purpose, then displayed action, then review a mismatch. Test your plan, read feedback and try a changed case. Save evidence; explain one limitation.
